_comment: Known accessibility debt, ignored audit-wide so the pa11y gate reports
REGRESSIONS rather than the launch state. Delete a code the moment its
findings are fixed: an entry that outlives its debt hides the next
regression behind it.
These are axe RULE ids, so an entry silences that whole rule on every
audited page. That is deliberately coarser than scripts/contrast/
accepted-risks.json (which pins per-scheme measured ratios): pa11y findings
key on generated selectors that churn with section ids, so a per-finding
baseline would go stale on every editor edit. The trade is that a NEW
instance of a baselined rule is invisible until the rule is cleared.
This file is read by scripts/a11y/summarize-pa11y.mjs, NOT by
build-pa11yci.mjs. pa11y runs unbaselined and reports everything; the
summariser applies the list and publishes both the rule names and a
per-rule count of what each one hid, so the CI Report cannot claim a clean
WCAG 2.1 AA pass over rules it never gated. That count is the signal for
when a rule is safe to delete: a rule hiding 0 findings is already clear.
For third-party embeds this theme cannot fix, prefer the per-path `ignore`
/ `hideElements` escape hatches in paths.json over an entry here.
STATE. Empty, and it should stay that way. This started at twelve rules
hiding 357 findings on PR #105's first run. Eleven were platform DOM
(moved to paths.json hides), a silent decorative video (a per-path
ignore), or real markup defects (fixed). The twelfth, color-contrast, was
hiding almost no measured failures at all: pa11y promotes axe's
INCOMPLETE results (background unmeasurable: text over an image, a
gradient, or an overlapping element) to errors by default, and those
made up virtually all of its count. build-pa11yci.mjs now caps
needs-review findings at `warning` (levelCapWhenNeedsReview), so measured
color-contrast violations gate again while the unmeasurable set is
disclosed as warnings in the CI report ('Needs review'). The one real
design surface behind them, what scheme-6's overlay text sits on, stays
visible through those per-run counts; no audit setting can measure text
composited over a photograph (rationale: release-notes.md).
